title: Building GenAI for Visual Storytelling with Divya & Dashtoon Co-Founder, Soumyadeep Mukerjee
summary: Divya talks with Soumyadeep, CTO and co-founder of Dashtoon, about teaching AI models to render specific comic styles — how he decomposes 'style' into character shape, eyes, color palette, strokes, and an entire 'universe' of defaults. They also walk through the layers of the modern AI stack (CUDA, PyTorch, diffusers, ComfyUI) and how fine-tuning makes character consistency possible for episodic storytelling.

intents.display: to hear a founder explain building genai for visual storytelling
